promptLatex: In triangle $ABC$, the angles measure $x$, $2x + 10$, and $3x - 10$ degrees at $A$, $B$, and $C$ respectively. What is the value of $x$?
hintLatex: The three angles belong to one triangle, so their total is fixed.
The interior angles of a triangle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
solutionLatex:
The three angles of a triangle have a fixed total of $180^{\circ}$.

$x + (2x + 10) + (3x - 10) = 180$

$6x + 10 - 10 = 180$

$6x = 180$, so $x = 30$.

Check: the three angles are $30$, $70$, and $80$, and $30 + 70 + 80 = 180$.
